summary: Transient mid-qualification drift guard (bin/ai-review-preflight:617), not a code defect and not the junction ERROR_UNTRUSTED_MOUNT_POINT class. Forced live canary via 'ai-review-preflight qualify gemini' passed on the first attempt (1 canary, 0 retries) and republished the qualification. Gemini is installed-healthy / usable:true.
details:
Root cause: Transient mid-qualification drift guard, not a code/config defect and not the ERROR_UNTRUSTED_MOUNT_POINT junction error.

The recorded failure line is:
  ai-review-preflight: Gemini wrapper, runtime, or model changed during qualification; untested bytes are not authorized and the previous qualification version stays valid.

That line is emitted by bin/ai-review-preflight:617 (qualify_gemini) when any of the wrapper SHA, agy version, agy SHA, or model differs between the pre-canary snapshot and the post-canary snapshot. The canary itself can succeed; the guard still refuses to authorize the bytes because something changed underneath it (typically a toolkit pull rewriting bin/ai-gemini, or agy self-updating) while the canary was in flight. Issue #1112 semantics: the prior qualification version is restored and stays valid, so the reviewer is not revoked - only the new bytes go unqualified.

Honest correction to the handoff characterization: HANDOFF.d/2026-10-06T2027Z-edge-dev-mimo-reviewer-durable-publish-and-incidents.md section 6 step 3 called this incident "same junction class as 20261006T022654Z". The evidence does not support that. Incident 20261006T022654Z failed with ERROR_UNTRUSTED_MOUNT_POINT on the C:\Users\ahazan\.gemini junction (to D:\ai-data\gemini). This incident's details.redacted.txt carries the drift-guard line and no mount-point error. The junction was checked during this repair and is a healthy Mount Point reparse tag 0xa0000003 to \??\D:\ai-data\gemini. Both incidents are automatic requalification failures of the provider "gemini", but they are different failure mechanisms and should not be treated as one root cause.

What was run (Git Bash at C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe, machine edge-dev):
1. bin/ai-review-preflight requalify gemini
   Output: "ai-review-preflight: gemini live qualification is current." exit 0.
   This is the hash-level staleness check. Installed bytes already matched the stored
   qualification record, so no canary ran. Passing here alone would not prove the live
   path, so a forced canary was run next.
2. bin/ai-review-preflight qualify gemini   (the documented "qualify gemini|qwen" verb,
   runs qualify_gemini unconditionally: doctor --identity, live qualify-live canary,
   doctor --identity again, drift guard, publish).
   START 2026-10-06T21:46:07Z (2026-10-06 5:46:07 PM EDT)
   Output (decisive success line):
     ai-review-preflight: Gemini live qualification recorded for wrapper 021ac7c9a3f81581150474f38420a612b54121cfab6da517a20374901d87645d, agy 1.3.0, and model gemini-3.8-flash-high.
   EXIT=0
   END   2026-10-06T21:48:18Z (2026-10-06 5:48:18 PM EDT)
   Canary attempts: 1. Retries needed: 0.
3. bin/ai-review-preflight requalify gemini  (post-canary confirmation)
   Output: "ai-review-preflight: gemini live qualification is current." exit 0.

Qualification record (the ID/locator for this repair):
  path: C:/Users/ahazan/.local/state/ai-devops/review-quarantine/gemini-live-qualified.json
  schema version 2, versions array length 5.
  publish_qualification_version dedupes by identity, so a same-identity canary refreshes
  the existing entry's qualified_epoch instead of appending a sixth version. The top-level
  entry and versions[4] now carry qualified_epoch 1791323296
  = 2026-10-06T21:48:16Z = 2026-10-06 5:48:16 PM EDT.
  Top-level identity: wrapper_sha256 021ac7c9a3f81581150474f38420a612b54121cfab6da517a20374901d87645d,
  agy_version 1.3.0, agy_sha256 c1b0001989c4051a41f5104484de182db5014fa155053c8088baacf1663063bf,
  model gemini-3.8-flash-high.

Post-repair state: bin/ai-review-preflight status gemini returns
  status "installed-healthy", usable true.
bin/ai-gemini doctor --identity returns the same agy 1.3.0 / c1b00019... / gemini-3.8-flash-high
identity before and after the canary, confirming zero drift on this attempt.

No code, configuration, or infrastructure change was made. No secrets were written. The
qualification record and this incident package are local and gitignored; nothing was
committed. Repair commit recorded is the toolkit HEAD at repair time, matching the
convention used by incident 20261006T022654Z-edge-dev-gemini-3639834 (which likewise
required no code change).
